## Yoshino Cherry Blossoms at the Tidal Basin

We visited the Tidal Basin in Washington, DC on two previous occasions to view the cherry blossoms. Each time we missed the peak bloom by a few days.

The second trip was from March 31 to April 1, 2018.

This year, we're trying again.

```{r data}

####################################################################################
## Cherry Blossom Analysis
####################################################################################

## Data from the National Park Service (2004-2021)
data <- read_csv(file=
    "Year,Buds,Florets,Extension,Peduncle,Puffy,Peak,End, Comment
     2021,Mar 11,Mar 16,Mar 22,Mar 24,Mar 26,Mar 28, Apr 06,

     2016,Mar 08,Mar 13,Mar 15,Mar 17,Mar 22,Mar 25, Apr 03,
     2015,Mar 18,Apr 01,Apr 04,Apr 06,Apr 08,Apr 10, Apr 19,
     2014,Mar 16,Mar 23,Mar 31,Apr 04,Apr 07,Apr 10, Apr 19,
```

\newpage

## Get the Data Formatted


```{r wrangle}

####################################################################################
## Data wrangling section
####################################################################################

## The anchor allows an interval before the first event. The value is arbitrary.
anchor <- "Feb 15"

## Make abbreviated dates for phases into full date strings with start and stop dates.
data2 <- data %>% 
   mutate(Quiescent = paste(anchor,Year,Buds,Year)) %>% 
   mutate(Peak_Range = paste(Peak,Year,End,Year)) %>% 
   mutate(Puffy_Range = paste(Puffy,Year,Peak,Year)) %>% 
   mutate(Peduncle_Range = paste(Peduncle,Year,Puffy,Year)) %>% 
   mutate(Extension_Range = paste(Extension,Year,Peduncle,Year)) %>% 
   mutate(Florets_Range = paste(Florets,Year,Extension,Year)) %>% 
   mutate(Buds_Range = paste(Buds,Year,Florets,Year)) %>% 
   rename(Peak_Bloom = Peak_Range, 
          Puffy_White = Puffy_Range, 
          Peduncle_Elongation = Peduncle_Range,
          Florets_Extension = Extension_Range, 
          Florets_Visible = Florets_Range, 
          Green_Buds = Buds_Range,
          group = Year) %>% 
   select(-Comment,-End, -Buds, -Florets, -Extension, -Peduncle, -Puffy, -Peak)

## Make the data into a long table (with just one row per event)
data3 <- data2 %>% 
  pivot_longer(!group, names_to = "event", values_to = "Range")

## Extract and reformat the range info into start and end dates.
## The end date is adjusted (minus 1 day) so there is no overlap.
data3$start <- as.character(mdy(substr(data3$Range,1,11)))
data3$end   <- as.character(mdy(substr(data3$Range,13,23))-1)

## Get the length of the interval.
## One day is added as you need to account for the day at the end of the interval (end day).
data4 <- data3 %>% 
  mutate(length = as.integer(ymd(end) - ymd(start) + 1))

## Sort the data by phase starting date.
data5 <- data4 %>% 
  arrange(start)

## Plots like to use factors.
data5$event <- as.factor(data5$event)
data5$group <- as.factor(data5$group)

## Data check
## head(data5,n=30)

```

\newpage

## Annual Phase Duration



```{r barplot}

####################################################################################
## Set up some plotting information
####################################################################################

## Establish the order of the phases (purposely backwards).
all_levels <- c(
  "Peak_Bloom",
  "Puffy_White",
  "Peduncle_Elongation",
  "Florets_Extension",
  "Florets_Visible",
  "Green_Buds",
  "Quiescent")

## Assign colors to each phase.
phase_colors <- c("pink",       ## Peak Bloom
                "white",
                "navajowhite3",
                "navajowhite",
                "lightyellow",
                "olivedrab",
                "#FFFFFF00")    ## Quiescent (transparent using Alpha value)

## Simplify the legend labels.
legend = c("Peak Bloom",
            "Puffy White",
            "Peduncle Elongation",
            "Florets Extension",
            "Florets Visible",
            "Green Buds",
            "")

####################################################################################
## Phase duration plot
####################################################################################

## Horizontal stacked bar chart showing the length of each phase. 
plot1 <- ggplot(data5, aes(x=group,y=length)) +
         geom_bar(aes(fill=factor(event, levels=all_levels)),
                       stat="identity") +
         coord_flip() +
         labs(x="Year",y=paste("Days from",anchor),fill="Phase") +
         scale_fill_manual(values=phase_colors,labels=legend) +
         labs(caption = "Data from NPS, with estimated Peak Bloom end values.") +
         theme(panel.background = element_rect(fill = "lightblue"))

ggsave("cherry_plot1.png",plot1,width=6.5,height=9)

```

\newpage

## Phase Duration Statistics


```{r phaselength}

####################################################################################
## Plots showing the length of each phase (with some data wrangling)
####################################################################################

## Eliminate rows with "Quiescent" and "Peak_Bloom".
data6 <- data5 %>% 
  filter(!event=="Quiescent") %>% 
  filter(!event=="Peak_Bloom")

## Data check
head(data6,n=20)

## Assign colors to each phase
phase_colors2 <- c(
                "white",        ## Puffy white
                "navajowhite3",
                "navajowhite",
                "lightyellow",
                "olivedrab")    ## Green buds
  
## Standard Bar Chart with the mean days for each event 
plot2 <- ggplot(data6) +
  geom_bar(aes(event, length, fill=factor(event, levels=phase_levels)), 
           stat = "summary", fun.y = "mean", show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_fill_manual(values=phase_colors2) +
  scale_x_discrete(limits=phase_limits) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks=seq(0,10,2)) +
  theme(panel.background = element_rect(fill = "lightblue")) +
  labs(x="Phase",y="Mean Length (days)",caption = "Data from NPS")
 
ggsave("cherry_plot2.png",plot2,width=6.5,height=9)

## Create sets of items used to control the plots.
phase_levels <- c("Puffy_White",
                  "Peduncle_Elongation",
                  "Florets_Extension",
                  "Florets_Visible",
                  "Green_Buds")

phase_limits <- c("Green_Buds",
                  "Florets_Visible",
                  "Florets_Extension",
                  "Peduncle_Elongation",
                  "Puffy_White")
## Standard Boxplot
plot3 <- ggplot(data6) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(event, length, fill=factor(event, levels=phase_levels)),
  show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_fill_manual(values=phase_colors2) +
  scale_x_discrete(limits=phase_limits) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks=seq(0,22,2)) +
  theme(panel.background = element_rect(fill = "lightblue")) +
  labs(x="Phase",y="Length (days)",caption = "Data from NPS")

ggsave("cheery_plot3.png",plot3,width=6.5,height=9)

## Dotplot
plot4 <- ggplot(data6,aes(x=event,y=length)) +
  geom_dotplot(binaxis="y", stackdir="center", dotsize=0.7) +
  scale_x_discrete(limits=phase_limits) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks=seq(0,22,2)) +
  theme(panel.background = element_rect(fill = "lightblue")) +
  labs(x="Phase",y="Length (days)",caption = "Data from NPS")

ggsave("cherry_plot4.png",plot4,width=6.5,height=9)
```


## Add some duration information

```{r dur}

development <- data2 %>% 
  mutate(start = mdy(substr(Green_Buds,1,11))) %>% 
  mutate(end = mdy(substr(Peak_Bloom,1,11))) %>% 
  mutate(period = as.integer(end-start)) %>% 
  select(group,start,end,period)
  
 development 
 
 ggplot (development,aes(x=1,y=period)) +
   geom_dotplot(binaxis = "y",stackdir="center",dotsize = 1.0) +
   theme(panel.background = element_rect(fill = "lightblue"),
         axis.text.x=element_blank(),
         axis.ticks.x = element_blank()) +
  labs(x="",y="Start to Peak (days)")
 
dev_stats <- summary(development$period)
dev_stats


ggplot(development,aes(x="",y=period)) +
  geom_boxplot(fill="olivedrab",size=1.5) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(10, 40)) +
  theme(panel.background = element_rect(fill = "lightblue")) +
  labs(x="",y="Start to Peak (days)")
```

## start stuff

```{r}

## Use an offset (anchor) to get the interval to the start of Green Buds.
## This gets rid of the "year" (here, group) so that just the month + day is used.
## The interval (days_start) can now be used to calculate statistics.
## The result will need to add back the anchor value to get dates (month & day).
data7 <- data6 %>% 
  filter(event=="Green_Buds") %>% 
  mutate(anchor = ymd(paste(group,"-2-15"))) %>% 
  mutate(days_start = as.Date(start)-anchor)

## Use this anchor again to get the actual date for the statistics.
anchor <- ymd("2021-2-15")

## Calculate the statistics of the start of the process.
early_start <- min(data7$days_start) + anchor
late_start <- max(data7$days_start) + anchor
mean_start <- as.integer(mean(data7$days_start)) + anchor
median_start <- as.integer(median(data7$days_start)) + anchor

## Get rid of the year



```
